-- made by @kylosilly on discord [dm/add me if any issues]
-- [Upgraded with Rayfield UI & Stop/Resume Feature by Agent]

local character = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
local map = game:GetService("Workspace").Map
local treasures = map.Treasures
local obby_land = map.ObbyLand

getgenv().settings = {
    -- main setting
    auto_farm = false, -- Default aku matikan agar tidak langsung jalan sebelum UI dipencet
    -- misc setting
    farm_treasures = true 
}

function get_time()
    return os.date("%X")
end

-- =======================================================
-- 📱 MOD MENU (UI RAYFIELD)
-- =======================================================
local success, Rayfield = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()
end)

if success then
    local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
       Name = "🏆 Auto Farm Hub",
       LoadingTitle = "Memuat Script Upgrade...",
       LoadingSubtitle = "by Agent & kylosilly",
       ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
       KeySystem = false
    })

    local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main Farm", 4483362458)

    Tab:CreateToggle({
       Name = "🚀 Aktifkan Auto Farm (Lanjut/Berhenti)",
       CurrentValue = false,
       Flag = "AutoFarmToggle",
       Callback = function(Value)
           getgenv().settings.auto_farm = Value
       end,
    })

    Tab:CreateToggle({
       Name = "💎 Auto Collect Treasures",
       CurrentValue = true,
       Flag = "TreasureToggle",
       Callback = function(Value)
           getgenv().settings.farm_treasures = Value
       end,
    })
end

-- =======================================================
-- ⚙️ BASE SCRIPT (Dipertahankan, hanya diubah sistem loop-nya)
-- =======================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5) -- Jeda aman agar game tidak freeze saat toggle dimatikan
        
        if getgenv().settings.auto_farm then
            local teleporters = obby_land.Teleporters
            local finish = obby_land.Finish
            
            if (#teleporters:GetChildren() == 0) or (#finish:GetChildren() == 0) then
                pcall(function() rconsoleprint("[Auto Farm] Teleporter or finish folder is empty. Attempting to fix. "..get_time().."\n") end)
                character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(obby_land.Model:GetPivot().Position))
                pcall(function() rconsoleprint("[Auto Farm] Empty folders fixed. "..get_time().."\n") end)
                task.wait(2)
            end
            
            local final_obby_teleporter = teleporters:FindFirstChild("11")
            local final_obby_finish = finish:FindFirstChild("11")
            
            if final_obby_teleporter and final_obby_finish then
                character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(final_obby_teleporter.Position))
                pcall(function() rconsoleprint("[Auto Farm] Starting last obby. "..get_time().."\n") end)
                task.wait(.5)
                fireproximityprompt(final_obby_teleporter.ProximityPrompt)
                task.wait(5)
                
                character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(final_obby_finish.Position))
                pcall(function() rconsoleprint("[Auto Farm] Teleported to the end. "..get_time().."\n") end)
                task.wait(.5)
                fireproximityprompt(final_obby_finish.ProximityPrompt)
                pcall(function() rconsoleprint("[Auto Farm] Claimed 20k. "..get_time().."\n") end)
                task.wait(.5)
            end
            
            -- Perbaikan: Menambahkan pengecekan toggle farm_treasures yang lupa dimasukkan author asli
            if getgenv().settings.farm_treasures then
                if (#treasures:GetChildren() < 3) then
                    continue
                end
                pcall(function() rconsoleprint("[Auto Farm] Collecting treasures. "..get_time().."\n") end)
                for _, v in pairs(treasures:GetChildren()) do
                    local prompt = v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt")
                    if (not prompt) then
                        continue
                    end
                    character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(v.Position + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)))
                    task.wait(.5)
                    fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local pGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Usuwanie starego GUI
if pGui:FindFirstChild("AutoFarmGui") then pGui.AutoFarmGui:Destroy() end

-- Tworzenie GUI
local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui", pGui)
sg.Name = "AutoFarmGui"

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.5, -50)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.Text = "Auto-Farm Obby"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.4, 0)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.45, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.Text = "OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold

local close = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 5)
close.Text = "X"
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.6, 0, 0)
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() sg:Destroy() end)

-- LOGIKA
local isFarming = false

local function FastTeleportAndTrigger(namePart)
    local char = Player.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return false end

    for _, v in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (v.Parent.Name:find(namePart) or v.ActionText:find(namePart)) then
            local targetCFrame = v.Parent.CFrame
            
            -- Szybki ruch (Tween)
            local t = TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {CFrame = targetCFrame})
            t:Play()
            t.Completed:Wait()
            
            -- Aktywacja
            v:InputHoldBegin()
            v:InputHoldEnd()
            task.wait(0.05)
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- PĘTLA FARMIEANIA
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if isFarming then
            local char = Player.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            
            if root then
                local startPos = root.CFrame
                
                -- Krok 1: Teleport do Obby
                FastTeleportAndTrigger("Teleport to obby 11")
                task.wait(0.2)
                
                -- Krok 2: Odbiór kasy
                FastTeleportAndTrigger("Claim 20000$")
                
                -- Krok 3: Powrót (opcjonalnie, żeby nie stać w miejscu nagrody)
                root.CFrame = startPos
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5) -- Czas między cyklami (zmień na mniejszy dla szybkości)
    end
end)

-- Przełącznik
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isFarming = not isFarming
    if isFarming then
        toggleBtn.Text = "ON (Farming...)"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 0)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "OFF"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
    end
end)
